titleSanskrit: सौप्तिक पर्व - रात्रिकालीन युद्धम् एवं अश्वत्थामा कोपः

verses.speaker: महर्षि व्यासः
verses.sanskrit:
॥ 1 ॥
एवमेतन्महाभाग धर्मराजस्य शासनम् ।
सर्वलोकहितार्थाय व्यासप्रोक्तं सनातनम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
|| 1 ||
Evametanmahābhāga dharmarājasya śāsanam |
Sarvalokahitārthāya vyāsaproktaṁ sanātanam ||
verses.hindi: [श्लोक 1 - सौप्तिक पर्व] हे महाभाग! धर्मराज के शासन में महर्षि व्यास द्वारा प्रोक्त यह सनातन ज्ञान समस्त लोकों के कल्याण के लिए है।
verses.english: [Verse 1 - Sauptika Parva] O Noble One! Spoken by Maharshi Vyasa under the reign of King Yudhishthira, this eternal wisdom serves the welfare of all worlds.
verses.commentary: Verse 1 of Mahabharata sauptika-parva (Sauptika Parva). Spoken in dialogue by महर्षि व्यासः.

verses.speaker: सूत जी (उग्रश्रवाः)
verses.sanskrit:
॥ 2 ॥
ततो दृष्ट्वा महात्मानं पाण्डवं सत्यविक्रमम् ।
हृष्टाः समभवन् सर्वे ऋषयो ब्रह्मवादिनः ॥
verses.transliteration:
|| 2 ||
Tato dṛṣṭvā mahātmānaṁ pāṇḍavaṁ satyavikramam |
Hṛṣṭāḥ samabhavan sarve ṛṣayo brahmavādinaḥ ||
verses.hindi: [श्लोक 2 - सौप्तिक पर्व] सत्यपराक्रमी महात्मा पाण्डव को देखकर समस्त ब्रह्मवादी ऋषि अत्यंत प्रसन्न हुए।
verses.english: [Verse 2 - Sauptika Parva] Beholding the noble Pandava of truthful valor, all the Vedic sages resonated with great joy.
verses.commentary: Verse 2 of Mahabharata sauptika-parva (Sauptika Parva). Spoken in dialogue by सूत जी (उग्रश्रवाः).

verses.speaker: वैशम्पायन उवाच
verses.sanskrit:
॥ 3 ॥
सत्यं वद धर्मं चर स्वाध्यायान्मा प्रमदः ।
एष धर्मः परो लोके सनातन इति स्मृतः ॥
verses.transliteration:
|| 3 ||
Satyaṁ vada dharmaṁ cara svādhyāyānmā pramadaḥ |
Eṣa dharmaḥ paro loke sanātana iti smṛtaḥ ||

verses.english: [Verse 3 - Sauptika Parva] Speak the truth, abide by righteousness, and neglect not self-study; this is remembered as the supreme eternal Dharma.
verses.commentary: Verse 3 of Mahabharata sauptika-parva (Sauptika Parva). Spoken in dialogue by वैशम्पायन उवाच.

verses.speaker: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच
verses.sanskrit:

तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन धर्मं गोपायत नराः ॥

|| 4 ||
Dharmeṇa jayate sarvaṁ dharmeṇa labhate sukham |
Tasmāt sarvaprayatnena dharmaṁ gopāyata narāḥ ||

verses.english: [Verse 4 - Sauptika Parva] By Dharma alone is everything conquered; by Dharma alone is true joy attained; hence human beings must protect Dharma with all efforts.
